titleSq: Tokë në shitje në Kodrën e Trimave, Prishtinë
titleEn: Land for sale in Kodra e Trimave, Prishtina
descriptionSq: Ofrohet per shitje truall me siperfaqe 60 ari, me lokacion ne Kodren e Trimave, Prishtine.
Trualli ka infrastrukture te plote, qasje ne rruge, ujesjelles, kanalizim, si dhe lidhje me energji elektrike.
I pajisur me flete poseduese dhe kontrata behet tek noteri.
Trualli ndodhet ne nje zone te zhvilluar me potencial te larte per ndertim rezidencial apo per veprimtari te ndryshme.
descriptionEn: Land for sale with an area of 60 ares, located in Kodra e Trimave, Prishtina.
The land has full infrastructure: road access, water supply, sewage, as well as an electricity connection.
It comes with an ownership certificate and the contract is signed at the notary.
The land is located in a developed area with high potential for residential construction or for various activities.
